children: Overview
Canada pharma firm's fiscal Q2 net revenue rose 18% yr/yr to a quarterly record
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company attributes growth to higher GRAFAPEX and IXINITY revenue, offset by generic competition in Canada
Outlook
Medexus expects GRAFAPEX product-level net revenue of $30 mln to $32 mln for fiscal 2027
Company expects GRAFAPEX annual product-level net revenue of $100 mln to $175 mln within five years post-launch
Medexus expects GRAFAPEX annual product-level adjusted gross margin to ultimately reach about 85%
Result Drivers
GRAFAPEX GROWTH - Co said increased product-level net revenue from GRAFAPEX drove quarterly records for net revenue and profitability
COMMERCIAL STRATEGY ENHANCEMENTS - Deployment of additional field force resources for GRAFAPEX aimed at increasing awareness and adoption
IXINITY DEMAND - Higher patient demand for IXINITY contributed to revenue growth, with patient unit demand in the US up 12% over the trailing 12-month period
